text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about with Eishin 
Flash...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Look, Umamusume plushies are being given 
out as prizes.

Looking where Eishin Flash pointed, there 
was a claw machine filled with plushies 
modeled after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
While it boldly foregoes precision, it 
captures the key features well and is 
quite cute.
choice_data_list: Why not give it a try?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...No, there is one problem with that. 
That is... this machine.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
While demanding delicate precision, the 
system refuses to allow even a millimeter 
of adjustment.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
And an arm shape completely unsuited for 
grabbing things. ...The conditions are far 
too unfair.
choice_data_list: In that case... leave this to me!
In that case... leave this to me!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I see, you're confident in this. Well 
then, Trainer, I'll leave it to you.
—I can't afford to lose this game!!
